prompt:
A desktop landing page for sqwer, a free touch-typing course for beginners and schools, rendered edge to edge as a finished website screen with crisp readable text, no browser window, no device, no desk.

The page is built as a great railway concourse departure board, translated into ultramarine: rows of split-flap tiles in deep ultramarine-ink with white painted letters, set in a porcelain and brushed-steel board frame, small brass lamps glowing on the live row. Ruled rows and fixed columns are the whole composition.

What leads: the board fills most of the first viewport. Its header reads "YOUR JOURNEY" with columns CHAPTER, DESTINATION, LESSONS, STATUS. Rows: "1  THE HOME ROW  14  BOARDING NOW" (brass lamp lit), "2  REACHING UP  14  NEXT", "3  REACHING DOWN  14", "4  CAPITAL LETTERS  8", "5  PUNCTUATION  10". Above the board, an elegant high-contrast serif headline set on the porcelain wall: "Learn to type properly, one key at a time." with "12 chapters, 125 short lessons, free." One calm white platform sign beside the board holds the single action: "Get started  →  Platform 1". A thin ticker along the foot of the board: "Today 1,284 lessons typed across sqwer".

Frame: the sqwer wordmark top left, navigation "Learn  Practice  Ranked" in small caps, "Sign in" at the far right. Condensed white sans on the flaps, the serif only for the headline. Corners barely softened.
note: Free-plan watermark; no reference images attached (OpenArt upload would exceed credits); style described in the prompt.
